subject.title: Stability, installer auth, runtime compatibility, and context-management improvements

question: How should maintainers split #86567 across secure dashboard auth recovery, OpenAI/Codex auth migration, installer/runtime atomicity, and long-session final-turn recovery?
rationale: Automation cannot safely choose credential persistence, OAuth propagation, installer ownership, or context-compaction recovery semantics from this broad field report without maintainer intent.

options.title: Split Into Canonicals
options.body: Keep this umbrella open only as tracking while maintainers route each subproblem to a narrow canonical issue or already-open sibling with explicit acceptance criteria.

options.title: Pick One Cross-Cut Program
options.body: Treat the report as a broader reliability program and assign owners across auth, installer/update, runtime, and session-state surfaces before any fix PRs start.

options.title: Close After Full Coverage
options.body: Close this umbrella only once every acceptance criterion is either implemented with proof or explicitly mapped to an open canonical issue.

recommendation.title: Split Into Canonicals
recommendation.body: Keep this umbrella open only as tracking while maintainers route each subproblem to a narrow canonical issue or already-open sibling with explicit acceptance criteria.

likelyOwner.reason: The highest-risk decisions intersect auth/provider migration, doctor policy, and terminal-state recovery, where steipete has recent history and policy context.
